name: Antagonize
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level adept 3, bard 3, lathspell 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You call out an insult charged with infuriating power. The target takes 1d4 damage per caster level (maximum 10d4). Additionally, the target must make an attack against a target of your choosing, using their attack of opportunity in the process. On a successful saving throw the target takes half damage and does not make the attack.
